newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0810 CST.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to off 0.200 cent. Further liquidation and spread unwinding seen. Cash markets easier.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to up 0.200 cent. Lower corn futures call and deferred live cattle should hold.
LEAN HOGS - Up 0.500 to 1.000 cent. Carryover from limit with Taiwan foot and mouth disease still main market factor.
PORK BELLIES - Up 1.000 to 2.000 cent. Carryover from limit on Taiwan. Cold Storage report later.
